utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Please do—just let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and keep you posted if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated parts by type? That would save us a ton of time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can sort the donated parts by type.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening as planned, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s not fully confirmed yet? Please let me know once you’ve checked the timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive! I can help, I just need to remember where I put the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a spare flyer if you need it—happy to hand you one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a lifesaver, Cleo—thank you. I’ll swing by and pick it up so I don’t lose the whole idea again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s double-check the repair drive details before we do anything. What’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think the plan is to gather the repair items and see what still needs fixing before we start. I might be missing a few details, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right—let’s list the repair items first, then we can sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by late and help with the repair drive if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Dane—thank you. Swing by late and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll come by after I wrap up here. Just point me to whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and check the tool table when you get a minute?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll sort the donations and check the tool table in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location—where should we meet up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s meet at the school parking lot by the gym entrance—I can be there after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — school parking lot by the gym entrance after drop-off. I’ll head there and keep an eye out for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already — folks seem pretty willing to pitch in. I can check what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thanks! I’ll spread the word and send anyone your way who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll see what’s still on the list and let you know. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rey—are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, we’re still on. How about 10 in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 10 works for me — where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll let everyone know and pass along any updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Uli. Let’s list the priority fixes and I’ll help coordinate the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d start with the leaky roof and the broken front step, then we can see what else needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll note the leaky roof and broken front step first, then we can ask the neighbors what else needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Eli — I heard the repair drive is getting set up soon, and folks are already starting to drop things off. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the details and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Please let me know the time and where to bring things, and I’ll plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — I heard about the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — could you help set up the tables and hand out the signup sheets? I’ll go over the plan with you in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can do that. Point me to the tables and I’ll start handing out the signup sheets.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. If you want, I can help sort the tools or check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Sorting the tools would help a lot—I’m a bit behind today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll start sorting them now, and you can tell me what to set aside for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you tell me where the repair drive is happening, and if there’s a specific drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet — can you send me the address or the drop-off spot details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you start with the neighbors on Maple and Pine, and anyone who’s mentioned broken appliances lately? If you can, please ask them to reply with what needs fixing so we can plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start with Maple and Pine and ask folks to reply with what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the latest update—what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still on for Saturday, but we shifted the focus a bit to small appliance fixes and bike tune-ups. If you want, I can send you the updated time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please send me the updated time and what to bring—I almost missed that shift.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still taking in repairs and sorting the big stuff first—if you’ve got tools, spare parts, or a little time, we can use the help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I can bring by a few spare parts and lend a hand for a bit. Just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you put up the flyers on your street and ask a few neighbors if they can donate tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll put up the flyers on my street and ask a few neighbors about donating tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the pickup time and where the stuff needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — can you tell me the pickup time and the drop-off address?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have that yet, so I can’t commit just now. If you send me the pickup time and drop-off address, I can check whether it works.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to save you a spot or send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, send me the details and save me a spot if you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll save you a spot and send the details right over. It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community center, and you can bring anything that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still waiting on the final time from the folks organizing it. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just send me the time when you get it, and I’ll work around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for updates from around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you, Nell — I’ll send out the first update soon and keep it moving.
